title: Quenched Portuguese Tofu Stir-fry
description: A light, earthy tofu dish with galangal-kha, creamy coconut sauce and Portuguese flavors, perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Drain and press the tofu for 15 minutes, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the sliced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and galangal-kha paste, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tofu cubes, red bell pepper, and green beans, cooking for 5 minutes, tossing frequently.
Pour in the coconut milk, squeeze in the lemon juice, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook until the sauce thickens slightly, about 4 minutes, and the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve the stir-fry hot over steamed jasmine rice or enjoy on its own.
